decisions.statement: The property speaks for every file beside the page with that extension.
A file under a folder beside the page is left to the folder's own property.
A page beside those files claims them, so nothing names each file one at a time.
A property saying these files hold bytes says so of every one of them.
A property saying these files are judged for no length says so of each of them.

definition: a page property held in the files beside a page closing with one extension
